blocks.prompt: 6. Find the domain and range of \(g(x) = \frac{x + 2}{3 - x}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh fraction (kasr) wala function hai jis ke neeche \(x\) hai. Fraction ka denominator kabhi zero nahi ho sakta, yahi domain ka faisla karta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(g(x) = \frac{x + 2}{3 - x}\).
Find kya karna hai? Domain aur range.
Plan: neeche ko zero banane wala \(x\) nikaal dena; range ke liye \(y = g(x)\) ko \(x\) ke liye solve karna aur dekhna kaunsa \(y\) namumkin hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(g(x) = \frac{x + 2}{3 - x}\).
Humein find karna hai: domain aur range.
Tareeqa: Domain: \(3 - x \ne 0\). Range: \(x\) ko \(y\) ki shakal mein likhenge. Us naye formula ka bhi neeche ek hissa hoga; jo \(y\) usay zero kare, woh kabhi output nahi ban sakta.

Domain
\[3 - x = 0 \Rightarrow x = 3\]
\[\text{Domain } g = (-\infty, 3) \cup (3, \infty)\]
Kyun: Zero se divide karne ka koi matlab nahi (misaal: \(\frac{5}{0}\) koi number nahi). Is liye sirf \(x = 3\) nikaalna hai; baqi har real number chalega. \(\cup\) ka matlab hai dono hisse mila do.

\(y = g(x)\) ko \(x\) ke liye solve karein
\[y(3 - x) = x + 2\]
\[3y - xy = x + 2\]
\[3y - 2 = x + xy = x(1 + y)\]
\[x = \dfrac{3y - 2}{1 + y}\]
Kyun: Pehle dono taraf \((3 - x)\) se multiply kiya taake fraction khatam ho. Phir bracket khola, \(x\) wali terms ek taraf (\(x + xy\)) aur baqi doosri taraf (\(3y - 2\)) jama kin. \(x\) common nikaala aur \((1 + y)\) se divide kiya.

Kaunsa output namumkin hai
\[1 + y = 0 \Rightarrow y = -1\]
\[\text{Range } g = (-\infty, -1) \cup (-1, \infty)\]
Kyun: \(y = -1\) par naye formula ka denominator zero ho jata hai, is liye koi \(x\) nahi milta. Har doosre \(y\) ke liye real \(x\) milta hai (aur woh \(x\) kabhi 3 nahi hota, kyunke \(x = 3\) ke liye \(3y - 2 = 3 + 3y\) chahiye, yani \(-2 = 3\), jo namumkin hai).
Shortcut: \(\frac{px + q}{rx + s}\) mein range se \(\frac{p}{r}\) nikalta hai; yahan \(\frac{1}{-1} = -1\). Lekin exam mein poora tareeqa likhein.

Tasdeeq: kya \(-1\) waqai kabhi nahi aata?
\[\dfrac{x + 2}{3 - x} = -1\]
\[x + 2 = x - 3 \Rightarrow 2 = -3\]
Kyun: \(-1\) output maan kar hal kiya to ghalat baat \(2 = -3\) aayi, yani aisa koi \(x\) nahi. Ek aur check: \(x = 1\) par \(g(1) = \frac{3}{2}\); formula mein \(y = 1.5\) rakhein to \(x = \frac{4.5 - 2}{2.5} = 1\). Bilkul theek.
